All are method pack workflow guidelines; no injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, credential reading inducement, or installation inducement was found. The copy injected by each host session hook (hooks/session-start, .github/hooks/session-start.json) is a reminder for the using-aegis hot path and legacy skill directory migration. The "YOU MUST TELL THE USER" instruction wording is a mandatory communication requirement for the migration warning; its content is consistent with the method pack routing discipline and has no malicious intent.

limits.zh: 审计预算有限，部分隐藏目录与大型测试/文档/基准数据目录无法逐字通读，相关机械命中依据预扫描摘录与仓库内文档裁决。未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。manifest 未显式声明能力，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断。插件为多宿主方法包，dsh 接入面为 extensions/dsh/，.opencode/plugins/aegis.js 等宿主适配器不在 dsh 评估范围内。
limits.en: Audit budget is limited; some hidden directories and large test/documentation/benchmark data directories could not be read word by word. Relevant mechanical hits are adjudicated based on pre-scan excerpts and repository documentation. Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts). The manifest does not explicitly declare capabilities; declared_capabilities are inferred from code measurement. The plugin is a multi-host method pack; the dsh integration surface is extensions/dsh/. Host adapters such as .opencode/plugins/aegis.js are not within the scope of the dsh evaluation.
